Zabbix released Zabbix 8.0 LTS, bringing major updates to its open-source infrastructure monitoring platform.

Key additions include native OpenTelemetry application performance monitoring, ClickHouse backend support for historical data offering up to a tenfold performance boost, and a complex event processing engine.
